scripts.render: npm run render:superviseur && npm run render:equipe && npm run render:prevention && npm run render:iso
scripts.render:superviseur: remotion render SuperviseurHSE out/capsule-superviseur-hse-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/capsule-superviseur-hse-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/capsule-superviseur-hse.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/capsule-superviseur-hse.mp4 -vf scale=720:-2 -c:v libx264 -crf 25 -preset slow -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart out/capsule-superviseur-hse-720p.mp4
